about_the_game:
SlimeCraft is a roguelike crafting game where you take control of a blue slime in a randomly generated world. You must mine objects to gather resources and manage your inventory to prepare for oncoming waves of enemies. Craft barricades and powerful magic items to build your defense, the longer you survive the higher your score. Find treasure, destroy spawners, and discover portals to other worlds as you continue exploring through space and time.

Controls:

Move with [WASD]

Press [Tab] to access inventory

Hold the [Left Mouse Button] to mine, craft, and attack

Press [Escape] to quit the game

Press [R] to restart the game

Scroll the [Mouse Wheel] to navigate the crafting menu

Click the [Right Mouse Button] to throw items away

Press [M] to mute audio and [P] to play audio

Hints:

  • Items won't disappear, you can come back for them later.

  • Waves of enemies come out each night and a horde of slimes is released on day three.

  • Enemies can stack on top of each other and deliver a more powerful blow to the player.

  • There's no point in saving food, heal up as soon as you can.

  • Enemies of the night can pass through barricades, slimes can potentially slip through them.

  • Make sure to build an offense, you can't survive with only barricades.

  • Moon magic can always hurt enemies of the night.

Credits:

Created by Jeremy Ulrich

Music by trndytrndy
